name: Protect Seireitei
desc: During daily Protect Seireitei event, guild which defends successfully will get rewards. Rewards will be sent by mail after event. Remark: There won't be any rewards if attacking guild wins. If there is no attacking guild, there won't be any rewards for defending guild.
